parsed.name: pharma_binary_basket
parsed.strategy: I bet on dated FDA binary events in Q4 2026 and Q1 2027, sized small because a CRL averages -33% over five days while approvals are largely priced in by the pre-date run-up. Large-cap pharma with heavy net analyst raises (MRK, ABBV, AMGN, LLY, VRTX) is ballast; the small PDUFA names (COGT, BBIO, AGIO, SMMT, PRAX, SVRA, CAPR) are the variance. I am wrong if a cluster of CRLs lands in November-December 2026, if the Section 232 tariff go-live on 2026-09-29 hits unshielded names like VRTX and ARGX, or if the small-cap binary tail is larger than the base rates imply.
parsed.objective: Maximise 126-session return vs SPY, net of costs, via dated pharma catalysts with CRL-tail-aware sizing
